posts.title: Linux on the Ayn Odin 2 Mini – Part 2
posts.description: Ubuntu Being unhappy with how outdated Debian’s packages were, I switched back to Armbian Ubuntu. Previously, this resulted in broken Vulkan support due to the newer Mesa, but this was remedied by using a newer Linux kernel. My custom 7.1 kernel from the previous post worked perfectly, allowing Vulkan to finally work correctly on Ubuntu. Continue reading "Linux on the Ayn Odin 2 Mini – Part 2"
